verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of an update process, changelogs, migration notes, or a repair or rollback path for Open WebUI. The only nearby hints are a version number cited in passing for MCP support and install-method mentions. Neither documents safe, versioned updating.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks
